div.p: This document represents the content for the Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) specifications for the initial population (IP) measure that informs CDC's NHSN Glycemic Control, Hypoglycemia module (1). This page is under construction and is in draft format.

The specification described here is for the initial population (IP) DQM. The IP dQM provides the necessary Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) line-level data necessary for calculating CDC’s NHSN Glycemic Control, Hypoglycemia module metrics (1). The IP measure is defined as all inpatient encounters, as well as emergency department (ED) and Observation (OBS) encounters that end within 1 hour of the start of the inpatient encounter, for patients of all ages where at least one antidiabetic drug (ADD) was ordered or administered during the encounter that is during the performance period.

The NHSN Glycemic Control, Hypoglycemia module provides a mechanism for facilities to report inpatient medication-related hypoglycemia events, and to provide analytic reports based on these data to inform glycemic control quality improvement efforts and patient safety events. The primary objective of the NHSN Glycemic Control, Hypoglycemia module is to facilitate measurement and benchmarking of medication-related hypoglycemia events within a facility. As additional data are collected by NHSN, an additional objective will be to facilitate inter-facility benchmarking and evaluate national-level trends of medication-related hypoglycemia over time. The IP dQM provides the FHIR line-level data necessary for calculating the module metrics.

The IP dQM provides the FHIR line-level data necessary for the NHSN Glycemic Control, Hypoglycemia module. This is for all patients ordered or administered ADDs from all inpatient locations for inpatient facilities enrolled in NHSN and using the Medication Safety Component, except for long-term care facilities (LTCFs) and outpatient dialysis facilities. ED and OBS encounters are also collected if they end within an hour of the inpatient admission (hospitalization). All participating facilities must have the ability to report data electronically to NHSN using the required HL7 FHIR specifications (2).
